# True Rankings

> Weekly college football rankings. How good they actually are. The order you check before you argue — not a poll, not a committee, not the narrative. Rankings, methodology, and weekly JSON stay free and simultaneous.

## Site

- Home (this week's board): {ORIGIN}/
- Methodology: {ORIGIN}/methodology
- Canonical week URLs: {ORIGIN}/{year}/week/{week}
- Team pages: {ORIGIN}/teams/{slug}
- Comparisons: {ORIGIN}/games/{team-a}-vs-{team-b}

## Machine-readable rankings

- Manifest: {ORIGIN}/rankings/manifest.json
- Week JSON: {ORIGIN}/rankings/{year}/week-{week}.json
- Week story: {ORIGIN}/rankings/{year}/week-{week}.story.json
- Live API (same origin): {ORIGIN}/api/rankings?year={year}&week={week}
- Team breakdown: {ORIGIN}/api/rankings/team/{Team%20Name}?year={year}&week={week}
- Comparison: {ORIGIN}/api/matchup?team_a={A}&team_b={B}&year={year}&week={week}

## How to cite

`True Rankings, {year} Week {week}, {ORIGIN}/{year}/week/{week}`

Rating name: **TR+** (True Rankings plus). Internal formula term FRS is methodology-only.
